target: 100% completion of the chosen original Windows route, spoiler-free

areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The Windows launcher, mode selector, character screen, and local save folder.
areas.note: Primary route: the original 1998 Windows game in its current rerelease.

levels.1: Check the title and release before creating completion saves.
levels.2: Install the current GOG or Steam release of Resident Evil 2 (1998).
levels.3: Install the classic Windows release from GOG or Steam and launch it without replacement campaign data. Confirm that Original Mode, Arrange Mode, Gallery, and the PC bonus modes appear; the 2019 remake belongs to a separate guide.

levels.1: The selected route already contains the required content for this entry.
levels.2: Complete this pack entirely in the chosen Windows release.
levels.3: Use only the Windows rerelease for this entry. Console-exclusive additions from other ports are outside the route selected in games.json, so they are neither required nor silently mixed into this checklist.

levels.1: Keep copies before choices that alter the partner scenario.
levels.2: Back up each A-scenario save before its first route-dependent choice.
levels.3: Close the game, copy the save folder to a dated location, and label the character, mode, difficulty, and A-route choices. Restore only while the game and cloud synchronization are closed; B scenarios inherit decisions from their linked A file.

levels.1: One first route creates the other character's linked continuation.
levels.2: Finish Leon A, save the clear data, then finish Claire B from it.
levels.3: Choose Leon for Scenario A on Original Normal, complete the route, and save when the clear-data prompt appears. Load that clear file rather than New Game to begin Claire B, then finish it to record the complete linked pair.

levels.1: Reverse the starting character for the second route pair.
levels.2: Finish Claire A, save the clear data, then finish Leon B from it.
levels.3: Choose Claire for Scenario A on Original Normal and preserve the resulting clear file. Load that file to start Leon B and finish the linked route; this pair contains different room access, equipment timing, and route mechanics from Leon A to Claire B.

levels.1: Several objects exist in only one route or character campaign.
levels.2: Track Leon A, Claire B, Claire A, and Leon B separately.
levels.3: Create four scenario columns plus columns for Original, Arrange, Hard, rankings, bonus modes, files, weapons, and secrets. Mark an entry only after performing it in the specified route; seeing the corresponding item in another scenario is not equivalent.

save_backup.title: Back up before building each linked pair
save_backup.why: A-scenario choices persist into the B clear data.

areas.name: Scenario Matrix
areas.location_cue: The city streets, police-station approaches, and four character-route selectors.
areas.note: SAVE-BACKUP: each A clear file is the only clean gateway into its linked B scenario.

levels.1: Follow this route without assuming the opposite character visits identical rooms.
levels.2: Start Leon and finish the full scenario through its clear-data result.
levels.3: Select Leon using Original Normal. Collect that route's files and character weapons, finish every mandatory physical puzzle, and save the result when prompted. Confirm the completion ledger records Claire B before overwriting any branch save.

levels.1: Follow this route without assuming the opposite character visits identical rooms.
levels.2: Start Claire from Leon clear data and finish the full scenario through its clear-data result.
levels.3: Select Claire from Leon clear data using Original Normal. Collect that route's files and character weapons, finish every mandatory physical puzzle, and save the result when prompted. Confirm the completion ledger records linked pair result before overwriting any branch save.

levels.1: Follow this route without assuming the opposite character visits identical rooms.
levels.2: Start Claire and finish the full scenario through its clear-data result.
levels.3: Select Claire using Original Normal. Collect that route's files and character weapons, finish every mandatory physical puzzle, and save the result when prompted. Confirm the completion ledger records Leon B before overwriting any branch save.

levels.1: Follow this route without assuming the opposite character visits identical rooms.
levels.2: Start Leon from Claire clear data and finish the full scenario through its clear-data result.
levels.3: Select Leon from Claire clear data using Original Normal. Collect that route's files and character weapons, finish every mandatory physical puzzle, and save the result when prompted. Confirm the completion ledger records linked pair result before overwriting any branch save.

items.label: Finish the Leon A / Claire B Pair

levels.1: Treat linked scenarios as one mechanical route with inherited choices.
levels.2: Complete Leon A and its resulting Claire B clear data consecutively.
levels.3: Finish Leon A, retain its clear file, and load that exact file for Claire B. Verify the basement locker, corridor shutter, laboratory gas, and fingerprint states reflect the A decisions before finishing the second scenario.

items.label: Finish the Claire A / Leon B Pair

levels.1: The reversed pair has its own equipment and route timing.
levels.2: Complete Claire A and its resulting Leon B clear data consecutively.
levels.3: Finish Claire A and load its clear data for Leon B. Collect the complementary character weapons, inspect the inherited zapping states, and keep this pair's clear files separate from the opposite starting order.

items.label: Record Both Scenario A Street Routes

levels.1: The two protagonists begin on opposite sides of the same obstruction.
levels.2: Play the opening streets once as Leon A and once as Claire A.
levels.3: Use separate New Game files for Leon A and Claire A. Visit each accessible storefront and cabin, collect the character-specific firearm, and reach the police-station entrance on both; keep a second item-free attempt for the Special Key.

levels.1: The linked routes enter the station through a different exterior approach.
levels.2: Reach the police station once in Claire B and once in Leon B.
levels.3: Load each opposite A clear file, traverse the rear exterior path, and collect the route-specific Cabin Key before entering. Do not overwrite the clear data until both B-entry item layouts have been checked.

save_backup.title: Preserve both A clear files
save_backup.why: Starting a B scenario from the wrong file loses inherited states.

point_of_no_return.title: Saving clear data commits the linked route
point_of_no_return.why: Keep the pre-clear save and resulting clear file under different names.

areas.location_cue: The PC main menu, Original and Arrange selectors, difficulty options, and Gallery tabs.
areas.note: The current Windows release exposes its bonus modes immediately, but their clears still count.

levels.1: Use the stricter PC ruleset for the main completion and weapon unlocks.
levels.2: Clear both A/B route pairs on Original Normal.
levels.3: Complete Leon A to Claire B and Claire A to Leon B on Original Normal. Use these four runs for the file, weapon, ranking, Special Key, and zapping ledgers because Easy cannot award the secret unlocks.

levels.1: A separate starting loadout demonstrates the assistance ruleset.
levels.2: Finish one representative Scenario A on Original Easy.
levels.3: Start a new Original Easy file, inspect the infinite Submachine Gun in the starting inventory, and finish one Scenario A. Record the clear separately; do not use it for costumes or infinite-weapon unlock conditions.

levels.1: This ruleset changes placements, assistance, supply size, and rank lettering.
levels.2: Clear both A/B route pairs on Arrange Normal.
levels.3: Complete all four scenarios in Arrange Normal, checking shifted item and enemy placements rather than following the Original layout blindly. Confirm three ribbons per pickup, auto-aim behavior, and the S-labelled top rank.

levels.1: One completed scenario adds a harder option to both mode families.
levels.2: Finish any scenario once and return to the mode selector.
levels.3: Complete any full scenario, save the clear data, and return to the main menu. Open both Original and Arrange selectors and confirm Hard is available in each; the PC release gives no separate reward for a Hard clear.

levels.1: Use a linked pair to verify the PC-exclusive higher difficulty.
levels.2: Finish one complete A-to-B pair on Original Hard.
levels.3: After unlocking Hard, begin either A character in Original Hard, finish and save clear data, then complete its linked B scenario on the same difficulty. Do not expect an additional item unlock.

levels.1: The second mode family also exposes its own Hard selection.
levels.2: Finish one complete A-to-B pair on Arrange Hard.
levels.3: Select Arrange Hard, complete either A scenario, save the clear result, and finish the linked B scenario. Verify the Arrange placement rules remain active alongside Hard combat values.

levels.1: Completed routes populate several art and model categories.
levels.2: Open Gallery Mode and inspect every populated thumbnail in every tab.
levels.3: After the four scenarios and bonus modes are complete, enter Gallery Mode. Open each available movie, rough sketch, illustration, and 3D model entry at least once; revisit after the final clear and confirm no newly filled thumbnail remains unopened.

areas.name: Rankings and Clear Unlocks
areas.location_cue: Result screens, clear-data prompts, the station entrance tunnel, Dark Room wardrobe, and subsequent Item Boxes.
areas.note: SAVE-BACKUP: protect finished clear data before testing unlocks or the ammunition input.

levels.1: Time, sprays, saves, and used infinite weapons determine the result.
levels.2: Finish an Original scenario with at least 270 ranking points.
levels.3: Finish within 2:30 for the full time score, avoid First Aid Sprays, minimize saves, and do not fire an unlocked infinite weapon. The four categories must total at least 270 for Original A.

levels.1: The equivalent top performance uses a different letter in Arrange.
levels.2: Finish an Arrange scenario at the top threshold and receive S.
levels.3: Use the same high-rank discipline as Original: target 2:30 or faster, heal with herbs, avoid saves, and leave infinite weapons unused. Arrange labels the top result S rather than A.

levels.1: The clock loses points in fixed half-hour blocks.
levels.2: Keep the result at or below 2:30 for 100 time points.
levels.3: The time category starts at 100 through 2:30. Each additional thirty-minute block removes ten points, so build route splits and pause only when the game actually stops its timer.

levels.1: One healing family is penalized; herbs are safe.
levels.2: Use no First Aid Sprays for 100 healing points.
levels.3: Heal with green, red, and blue herb mixtures. Each used First Aid Spray removes ten points, and three or more sprays reduce this category to zero.

levels.1: Every typewriter use reduces the result slightly.
levels.2: Use zero saves for the full 100 save points.
levels.3: The save category begins at 100 and loses five points per save. A clear-data write after the result is not part of the completed run's typewriter count.

levels.1: Owning an unlocked weapon is safe; firing it is not.
levels.2: Leave infinite weapons unused during ranking attempts.
levels.3: An infinite weapon may remain in the Item Box without penalty. Equipping and using one removes fifty ranking points, so use ordinary ammunition until the result screen appears.

levels.1: A clean Scenario A street run makes an optional enemy appear below the entrance.
levels.2: On Original Normal Scenario A, reach the station without taking any street item.
levels.3: Start Scenario A on Original Normal and take nothing between the crash site and police-station front entrance. Enter the small tunnel below the steps, defeat the uniformed optional enemy, and collect the Special Key from it.

levels.1: A key from the station entrance opens the Dark Room wardrobe.
levels.2: As Leon, use the Special Key on the Dark Room locker.
levels.3: Carry the Special Key to the first-floor Dark Room and unlock the wardrobe as Leon. Try both the biker outfit and alternate police outfit; either changes his handgun stance and slightly improves handgun firing speed.

levels.1: The same wardrobe contains a different character reward.
levels.2: As Claire, use the Special Key on the Dark Room locker.
levels.3: Repeat the item-free Scenario A entrance as Claire or collect the key in her linked route, then unlock the Dark Room wardrobe. Equip the biker outfit once and take the Colt S.A.A. from the locker.

levels.1: Claire's wardrobe reward is also a distinct handgun.
levels.2: Take the Colt S.A.A. from Claire's unlocked Dark Room locker.
levels.3: Open the Special Key wardrobe as Claire and collect the six-round Colt S.A.A. It uses ordinary handgun bullets but fires faster and hits harder than her starting handgun; fire and reload it once.

levels.1: A fast, high-ranked A scenario awards a clear-data weapon.
levels.2: Finish any Original Normal Scenario A under 2:30 with rank A or B.
levels.3: Use an A scenario, finish before 2:30, and keep the result at A or B. Save the clear data, load the next main-game run from it, and verify the Infinite Rocket Launcher appears in the Item Box.

levels.1: The B-route firearm allows a slightly longer time limit.
levels.2: Finish any Original Normal Scenario B under 3:00 with rank A or B.
levels.3: Complete a B scenario before three hours with an A or B result, save its clear data, and load the following main-game cycle. Confirm the infinite Submachine Gun is stored in the Item Box.

levels.1: The strictest B-route reward also forbids saving.
levels.2: Finish any Original Normal Scenario B under 2:30, rank A or B, with zero saves.
levels.3: Run a B scenario from start to finish without using a typewriter, end before 2:30, and earn A or B. Save only at the post-result prompt, load the next cycle, and inspect the Item Box for the Infinite Gatling Gun.

levels.1: A classic directional sequence can alter the currently held weapon.
levels.2: At the inventory screen, tap Up twice and Down twice; alternate Left and Right twice, then press Aim.
levels.3: Open the item screen during a disposable save and highlight a weapon. Tap the upward direction twice, the downward direction twice, alternate left and right for two cycles, and finish with Aim. Return to play and verify ammunition no longer decreases; keep this branch separate from ranked clears.

save_backup.title: Keep an unmodified ranked clear file
save_backup.why: Testing cheats or overwriting clear data can obscure which reward was earned.

areas.name: Survivor Bonus Modes
areas.location_cue: A reverse route from the sewers through the police station to an exterior endpoint.
areas.note: Both modes are available immediately in the PC rerelease; completion still requires a clear.

levels.1: The PC version starts this compact escape mode unlocked.
levels.2: Select 4th Survivor and reach the surface endpoint from the sewer start.
levels.3: Open the bonus-mode menu, choose 4th Survivor, and plan inventory slots before moving. Evade dense groups where possible, spend heavy ammunition only to open blocked lanes, conserve healing for the final station corridors, and reach the outdoor endpoint.

levels.1: Repeat the route after learning where enemies block narrow doors.
levels.2: Complete 4th Survivor without continuing or restarting from a failed attempt.
levels.3: Memorize safe-side door entries, bait lunges before narrow turns, and reserve at least one full heal for the final exterior stretch. Finish in one uninterrupted attempt and retain the result screen in the completion ledger.

levels.1: This variant removes firearms and emphasizes movement.
levels.2: Select Tofu Survivor and reach the surface using only its supplied knife and herbs.
levels.3: Open Tofu Survivor from the PC bonus menu. Use the knife only when a body fully seals a doorway, combine herbs for maximum recovery, take deliberate damage to pass unavoidable grabs, and preserve healing for the upper station and exterior finish.

items.label: Record a Clean Tofu Survivor Run

levels.1: A second attempt verifies the knife-only route rather than a lucky finish.
levels.2: Complete Tofu Survivor in one uninterrupted attempt.
levels.3: Practice the same route until doorway baits and damage boosts are repeatable. Finish without restarting, using no equipment beyond the mode's supplied knife and herbs, and record the final result screen.

areas.location_cue: The laboratory monitor room, reverse factory and sewer route, and eight candidate rooms inside the police station.
areas.note: Complete all twelve character-and-level combinations; bomb placement can vary.

levels.1: Move from the laboratory to the station and search a rotating room set.
levels.2: Collect four Antivirus Bombs in the police station, then leave the room holding the fourth.
levels.3: Begin at the laboratory monitor room, travel backward through the factory and sewers, and reach the police station. Search the eight candidate rooms until the fourth bomb is collected, then exit that room to trigger the completed run.

levels.1: Each character's inventory changes which encounters are worth fighting.

levels.3: Select Leon and Level 1. Preserve the character's strongest ammunition for narrow factory and sewer rooms, search the complete candidate-room loop, collect the fourth bomb, and leave that room to complete the run.

areas.name: Secrets and Gallery Audit
areas.location_cue: Readable city signs, station walls and furniture, the Dark Room, and the PC Gallery viewer.
areas.note: SAVE-BACKUP: the hidden gate view closes when the opening street condition is missed.

levels.1: One ordinary office desk rewards extreme persistence.
levels.2: Examine Wesker's S.T.A.R.S. Office desk fifty times, then develop Film D.
levels.3: Stand at Wesker's desk, repeat the same examine action until Film D appears, carry it to the Dark Room, use the development tray, and inspect the resulting hidden photograph. This also completes the Film D file entry.

levels.1: The optional camera angle requires breaking the item-free street condition.
levels.2: In Scenario A, take a street item, clear the front passage, then inspect the station gate.
levels.3: Begin an A route and deliberately pick up a street object, which cancels the item-free key condition. Clear the two enemies from the narrow passage below the entrance, face outward at the gate, and use the action control to trigger the concealed view.

levels.1: A basement camera reacts to a powerful shot aimed out of the scene.
levels.2: In the dog-fence basement passage, change camera angle and fire the Shotgun toward the screen.
levels.3: Reach the basement passage where two dogs cross the fence, return toward the manhole until the camera changes, equip the Shotgun, face outward toward the camera, and fire. Inspect the screen for the temporary impact marks.

levels.1: Pause around readable signs, posters, lockers, and wall art.
levels.2: Inspect the street storefront for Arukas Store Sign.
levels.3: Reach the street storefront, clear enough space to stand safely, and read the sign as Sakura reversed. Move close enough for the texture or lettering to be legible before marking the reference complete.

levels.1: Pause around readable signs, posters, lockers, and wall art.
levels.2: Inspect the wall behind the gun shop for Above the Rim Graffiti.
levels.3: Reach the wall behind the gun shop, clear enough space to stand safely, and inspect the basketball-film reference. Move close enough for the texture or lettering to be legible before marking the reference complete.
